newsitem.title: CHINA: China names shipping firms for Taiwan route.
newsitem.headline: China names shipping firms for Taiwan route.

text.p: China has cleared five of its shipping companies, including major national line China Ocean Shipping, for direct shipping service to Taiwan, Chinese officials said on Wednesday.
Officials of the Ministry of Communications said the other four were all companies from the southeastern province of Fujian, which faces Taiwan.
The companies were named as Fujian Provincial Shipping Co Ltd, Xiamen Shipping Co Ltd, Mawei Shipping Co Ltd and Fujian Foreign Trade Centre Shipping Co Ltd.
All must still receive formal approval from Taiwan but that was expected soon.
There was no word on which Taiwan companies would be approved but Chinese officials have said they were processing applications.
Taiwan has banned direct trade with rival China since the end of the Chinese civil war in 1949 though it has allowed commercial ties through other territories, usually Hong Kong.
But it has come under increasing pressure from its own businessmen as well as from Beijing to permit direct shipping and air links.
The two sides have reached agreement on direct crossings between Taiwan's southern port of Kaohsiung and China's port of Xiamen with inaugural sailings expected as early as next week.
Taipei says it is limiting the new service to connections with Kaohsiung for transshipment to destinations not on Taiwan.
